leadText:
Gerbera Town (Japanese: ガーベラタウン Gerbera Town) is an -exclusive location in Sinnoh. Like many other in the region, it is home to a Contest Hall, attracting several Pokémon Coordinators who wish to compete in the Sinnoh Grand Festival.

It was featured during Marian's television show in A Breed Stampede!, in which it was revealed that had recently won a Pokémon Contest that was being held there, in the process earning his third Ribbon with the help of his .
